what.title: What is Tallaby?
what.lead: Tallaby is an Egyptian platform for building an online store under your own brand and running it yourself.
what.who: For sellers on Facebook, Instagram or WhatsApp who want a real store without code.

store.title: A store with your name on it
store.body: Your logo and colours, at <domain>yourbrand.tallaby.com</domain> or on a domain you own.

money.title: Your sales come to you
money.body: Cash on delivery, InstaPay and wallets, or cards through your own Paymob or Kashier account. Tallaby takes no cut of your sales.

shipping.title: You choose how to ship
shipping.body: Tallaby doesn't deliver orders. Ship through your Bosta account or your own riders.

world.title: Sell in Egypt and abroad
world.body: Choose your store's currency and the countries you ship to.

features.title: Built for the way people sell online today
features.mcpTitle: Manage your products by chatting with <claude>Claude</claude> or <chatgpt>ChatGPT</chatgpt>
features.mcpBody: Connect your account once. Then ask the assistant to add products or change prices, and it does it in your store.
features.aiBody: From a photo or a few lines: title and description in Arabic and English, with category and SEO.
features.marketingBody: Email campaigns, discount codes, and WhatsApp follow-up on unfinished orders.
features.importBody: From Excel, from a product link, or straight from Shopify.
features.adsBody: Meta Pixel and Conversions API, GA4 and GTM, plus product feeds for Meta and Google.

templates.title: Start from a design made for what you sell
templates.body: {count, plural, one {{count} ready template} other {{count} ready templates}}. Edit any section with Drag & Drop, and switch templates any time without losing your products.

pricing.title: Two simple plans, switch any time
pricing.body: Start free and pay a few cents per order, or go Pro for a flat monthly price.

faq.title: Questions before you start
faq.desc: Can't find your answer? <link>Message us on WhatsApp.</link>

items.q: What does an order cost on the free plan?
items.a: {orderFee} per order, with no monthly fee and no percentage of sales. Make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days to see your orders, send campaigns and keep your store online.
From about 1,000 orders a month, the flat {pro} costs less than per-order fees.
Yes. Choose your store's currency and the countries you ship to, and shoppers see prices in that currency.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. Your store starts on yourbrand.tallaby.com, and you can connect a domain you own from Website › Domain.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Design, products, payments and shipping are all set up from your dashboard.

final.title: Your store link is waiting
final.body: Claim it now. Design and publish whenever you're ready.
